title: Unshared files and folders are displayed as "Shared"
body:

To make it possible for us to help you please fill out below information carefully.

### Steps to reproduce
1. Configure Authentik saml provider. 
2. Configure Nextcloud user_saml to connect to Authentik provider.
3. Create Authentik user account 
4. Log in via Authentik
5. Navigate to Nextcloud
6. Go to logged in Nextcloud files and folders web interface

### Expected behaviour
Unshared files and folders should not have any tag stating "Shared by <user>" when they are the original creator and owner of these files and folders. This user should not be "sharing files and folders to themselves".  

![nextclouduser](https://github.com/nextcloud/user_saml/assets/50882116/e1116887-2ae6-41cf-92ed-0749a56c0dba)

This is a user account (test2) that was created directly via Nextcloud and logged in to via "https://my-nextcloud-domain/login?direct=1".

### Actual behaviour
Unshared files and folders all display "Shared by <logged in user>" as if the user is sharing the files and folders to themselves. 

![unsharedfiles](https://github.com/nextcloud/user_saml/assets/50882116/947ec156-6ea4-401f-adfb-e5f53ee16583)

This is a user account (tester) that was created via Authentik and logged in to via Authentik / Nextcloud user_saml.

comments.author: participant4
comments.body:
I encountered a similar issue where files that are not shared by the user display as "Shared" in the web interface. I deployed my private instance using Docker. After multiple tests, I summarized the following observations:

1. The issue of files displaying as "Shared" occurs in major versions 29 and 28, but not in version 27.
2. The issue only arises when the user's UID is set to pure numbers.
3. This issue seems unrelated to the source of the user. I have tried various user sources, including local users and LDAP users, as well as local login and identity provider SSO login. As long as the user's UID is pure numbers, the issue occurs.
